title: Torch
summary: A fantasy torch asset used to study layered wood, metal, and weathered surface treatment inside a compact prop format.

brief: The torch was built as a small but useful study in wood, metal, and wear language.

sections.title: Layered surface read
body: Because the form is simple, the asset depends on clean transitions between the wood and metal treatment.

outcomes: A practical prop reference for future environment and inventory sets
